mechanism: CNeuronLowLevelReflection runs parallel LSTM and Mamba recurrent streams on the environment tensor to extract short-term parameter dynamics, then stacks two relative cross-attention blocks that enrich the current state with each stream’s change embedding before a memory module stores persistent trends for next-step price-path context.
data_needed: Multimodal OHLC/indicator state window; OpenCL LSTM+Mamba+cross-attention weights; memory heads/window_key
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 (series continues in 16867; train 2023 / test Jan 2024 in final)
why_new_for_mis: Dual-architecture short-horizon change sensor (LSTM for classical temporal memory + Mamba for selective long-range) fused by cross-attention—MIS can treat the dual change embedding as a regime-transition precursor without LLM text.
quote: Using different architectural solutions for these objects ensures deeper analysis, allowing the system to adapt effectively to both short-term and long-term changes, detecting trends across multiple time scales.

mechanism: CNeuronHighLevelReflection ingests environment state plus account-status vector; LSTM tracks account and action histories; cross-attention scores action-vs-state justification then action-history-vs-account-result effectiveness, outputting a latent action tensor that adapts the agent’s behavioral policy from realized PnL.
data_needed: Agent action tensor (volume, SL, TP per side); account description vector; environment state after bar transition
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; bar-triggered iterations with history depth ≫1 bar
why_new_for_mis: Policy-effectiveness sensor that correlates executed trades with balance-path outcomes—MIS can expose a live ‘strategy health / regime fit’ feature separate from raw price regime.
quote: we evaluate the effectiveness of the agent's policy by comparing trading activity dynamics with account state within the cross-attention block.

mechanism: After z-score-style normalization (zero mean, unit variance), classical indicator readings become oscillators; OpenCL MoreLessEqual kernel maps |value|>1.2e-7 to buy(+1)/sell(−1)/flat(0); trainable Key/Value projections in cross-attention learn possible signal inversion without raw threshold tables.
data_needed: Normalized indicator feature tensor; CNeuronMoreLessEqual; FinAgent decision cross-attention
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; default indicator settings; train 2023, test Jan 2024 (95 trades, PF 1.09)
why_new_for_mis: Distribution-invariant prior-knowledge sensor that recovers classical buy/sell polarity from normalized features—MIS can fuse expert-rule polarity with neural state without brittle raw thresholds.
quote: each variable becomes comparable to others and can be interpreted as a kind of oscillator. This provides a universal signal interpretation scheme: values above 0 are treated as buy signals, and values below 0 as sell signals.

mechanism: Market Analysis Module runs CNeuronPSformer (segmented-attention transformer) then memory; two low-level reflection modules analyze the pattern tensor and its transpose (time-step vectors vs univariate series), fused by cross-attention before enriching only stable memory patterns in the decision stack.
data_needed: BarDescr×HistoryBars multimodal series; Segments; PSformer + dual CNeuronLowLevelReflection
why_new_for_mis: Dual-projection neural market-structure sensor that separates cross-sectional bar relations from univariate dynamics and gates decisions on memory-stable patterns only—MIS sequence feature for noise-robust regime embedding.
quote: In the first case, we analyze a multivariate time series, where each time step is represented by a data vector… In the second case, we analyze individual univariate sequences to detect dependencies and regularities in their dynamics.

mechanism: BinaryPatternGenerator emits 0/1 encodings: direction, momentum(|ret|>θ), volume>rolling mean, MA fast>slow, volatility=(H−L)>ATR-like avg, RSI>50, Bollinger %B>0.5; window sums/last/last-3 concatenate with 8-qubit measurement histogram features for CatBoost direction classification.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; window≈10; forecast_window=5; ~1000 bars hybrid test
why_new_for_mis: Compact binary micro-regime bank (vol, volume, RSI, BB position) usable as MIS discrete sensors independent of the weak quantum branch.

mechanism: Qiskit circuit puts qubits in Hadamard superposition, RY-encodes scaled SMA/EMA/std/BB/RSI/momentum/ROC and current price, CNOT-entangles neighbors, measures 2000 shots; predicted price = mean of bitstring-mapped moves capped at ±0.1%; confidence = 1 − std(predictions)/price; up/down probabilities from fraction of shots.
data_needed: MT5 H1 rates; 8 qubits; MinMaxScaler; AerSimulator shots=2000
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; ~54–55% directional accuracy in classical-quantum path
why_new_for_mis: Measurement-dispersion confidence as an uncertainty sensor alongside directional probability—MIS can gate trades when shot consensus is low even if point forecast looks decisive.

mechanism: Binary up/down sequences of length 5–8 (optionally 12) get frequency, winrate, and reliability=frequency×winrate×(1−|0.5−winrate|); features enrich LSTM inputs together with ATR volatility, ADX trend strength, and identify_market_phase; decisions require ≥60% pattern–ML agreement and raise reliability thresholds under high ATR.
data_needed: Close diffs as 0/1; pattern_lengths; forecast_horizon≈6; ATR/ADX; LSTM(256→128)+Dense
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H4 example pattern [1,1,1,0,0] ~68% winrate/>200/yr; analysis window 10 steps
why_new_for_mis: Symbolic pattern reliability that self-penalizes suspiciously high winrates, conditioned on volatility/trend-phase context—MIS hybrid regime+change sensor with interpretable priors.

mechanism: Compute rolling ATR; volatility_ratio=ATR_t/mean(ATR); form a new bar when price range ≥ base_threshold×volatility_ratio so bars expand in calm regimes and contract in storms; on BTCUSD bar-formation frequency rises exponentially before explosive moves.
data_needed: Tick/OHLC stream; base_threshold; ATR lookback (e.g. 20); optional 0.5 ATR Range / 0.1% ADV Volume thresholds
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 2024-10-01→2025-01-15 stats; BTCUSD; gold; GBPUSD; USDJPY Tokyo; S&P500 futures
why_new_for_mis: Event-time sampling keyed to local volatility regime—MIS can use bar-size/frequency itself as a live vol-regime and change-intensity sensor rather than fixed TF bars.
quote: During quiet periods, the bars stretch out, giving a clearer picture. In stormy times, they contract so as not to miss important movements.

mechanism: Acceleration bars accumulate |d²price/dt²| until threshold (good pre-market equity impulse; noisy on crypto); New High/Low Sequence bars fire after N consecutive extreme updates or time cap (best sequence_threshold=3 on EURUSD trends), labeling sequence_type up/down and count as persistence strength.
data_needed: Timestamped closes; acc_threshold; sequence_threshold; time_threshold seconds
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: S&P500 futures; US equities pre-market; USDJPY Tokyo; EURUSD trends; crypto caution for acceleration
why_new_for_mis: Price-acceleration energy and consecutive-extreme persistence as impulse/change sensors—MIS early-warning features for breakout vs grind regimes.
quote: before strong movements, the price does not just accelerate, but does so in a specific pattern.

mechanism: Treat each discretization (Momentum, Volatility Regime, New High/Low, Kagi, …) as an expert: Momentum for move force, Vol-Regime for sizing, New High/Low for trend confirm, Kagi to reject false signals; EURUSD test claimed +12% accuracy, −23% false positives, −15% drawdown vs single bar type.
data_needed: Parallel bar constructors; per-type predictability stats (autocorr/ADF/entropy); ensemble combiner
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M15 panel; Renko/Kagi/Three-Line Break also shown
why_new_for_mis: Cross-discretization consensus as a meta-sensor of which market ‘lens’ currently carries signal—MIS can route features by active expert rather than one fixed sampling.
quote: what if we used different types of bars as individual "experts" in the ensemble? Each type of bar "sees" the market in its own way

mechanism: CNeuronMemoryDistil keeps LSTM short-term + Mamba long-term recurrent memories, concatenates/transposes/compresses them via conv+embedding into a FIFO episodic stack, then relative cross-attention retrieves similar past episodes to enrich the current state for conceptual comparison.
data_needed: State tensor; stack_size; window/window_key/heads; embedding projection matrices
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 framework (tested in 16937 on 2024 train / Jan 2025)
why_new_for_mis: Explicit episodic retrieval over compressed market states—MIS neural sensor for ‘have we seen this microstructure before’ beyond flat rolling windows.
quote: the cross-attention block plays a critical role… to find the most relevant episodes… [and] enrich the original state with context from selected episodes.

mechanism: Intra-episode risk control reacts in real time to curb short-term losses; inter-episode evaluation compares completed trajectories to revise beliefs; Conceptual Verbal Reinforcement Feedback (CVRF) contrasts successful vs unsuccessful episode concepts and selectively routes belief updates from Manager to Analysts via action-overlap measures.
data_needed: Episode trajectories of analyst insights + manager actions; overlap metric between consecutive learning trajectories
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Financial trading/portfolio setting; EURUSD H1 in MQL5 reimplementation
why_new_for_mis: Two-timescale risk/belief sensor separating tactical drawdown control from episodic policy critique—MIS can maintain short-horizon risk state and long-horizon strategy-fitness state jointly.
quote: Intra-episode risk assessment allows for real-time corrective actions to minimize short-term losses. Inter-episode risk evaluation compares results across episodes to identify mistakes and improve strategies.

mechanism: Each CNeuronFinConAgent holds a trainable role MLP (fixed-1 → 10×window embedding) used only in training; cross-attention perception filters environment patterns by role; separate state and action MemoryDistil modules feed parent cross-attention that revises the agent’s recommended trade tensor.
data_needed: Environment window; action_space; stack_size; role embedding length 10×window
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1 2024 train / Jan 2025 test (47 trades, 42% wins; needs more opt)
why_new_for_mis: Role-conditioned attention as a soft specialist sensor—MIS can run parallel role embeddings (trend/risk/flow) without hand-labeled regimes.
quote: the trainable query tensor becomes a key tool for identifying and reinforcing the most suitable developmental trajectory.

mechanism: Supervised LSTM (time_step=5, features ADX/RSI/stationary return) regresses the mean of the next 10 ADX values; golden-cross MA(15/25) entries fire only if predicted ADX > threshold (e.g. 30); ONNX deploy in MQL5; sliding-window retrain recommended.
data_needed: iADX/iRSI/stationary return CSV; Keras LSTM→ONNX; threshold
why_new_for_mis: Forward-looking trendiness sensor (future ADX) that avoids lagging current ADX peaks—MIS regime gate for trend-following vs chop without waiting for ADX to already be high.
quote: We aim to predict its future value instead of using its current value, as a high ADX typically indicates that a trend has already occurred or is ending

mechanism: Original MacroHFT labels fixed-length blocks by (1) low-pass filter + linear-regression slope → bullish/neutral/bearish trend and (2) mean absolute price change quantiles → high/medium/low volatility, yielding six market categories that specialize DDQN sub-agents; MQL5 port lets a Softmax hyper-agent with MemoryDistil infer soft class weights end-to-end.
data_needed: Minute bars; low-pass + slope; quantile thresholds from train set; 6 sub-agents + hyper-agent Softmax
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Cryptocurrency HFT on M1 (paper); MQL5 tests on EURUSD M1 (final part)
why_new_for_mis: Explicit 3×2 trend×volatility taxonomy as a compact MIS regime codebook, with optional learned Softmax mixture replacing hard labels.
quote: each data block receives two labels: one for trend and one for volatility. As a result, we have six market condition categories, combining trend types (bullish, neutral, bearish) and volatility levels (high, medium, low).

mechanism: CNeuronMacroHFTvsRiskManager memory-distills trade-action sequences and account-state vectors, expands account into trainable projections, then relative cross-attention aligns recent actions with balance dynamics; residual conv emits volume/SL/TP so trade size scales with implied forecast confidence and recent policy PnL path.
data_needed: NActions trade tensor; AccountDescr; dual MemoryDistil stacks; cross-attention heads
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M1; train on 2024 (24×1-month passes); test Jan 2025 (8 trades, PF 2.47 over ~2 weeks)
why_new_for_mis: Account-path-conditioned risk/size sensor linking action sequences to equity outcomes—MIS can expose confidence-scaled exposure state for HFT or fast discretionary books.
quote: By correlating agent actions with financial changes, the relationship between decisions and outcomes is revealed.

mechanism: Dialectical Algorithm splits a population into speculative and practical thinkers that update via antithesis selection (far in space / near in quality vs near in space); tested on Hilly/Forest/Megacity synthetic benchmarks—metaheuristic parameter search, not a market-state sensor.
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing after full read—optimization algorithm for continuous/discrete test problems only.
quote: Dialectic Search (DA) was introduced by Serdar Kadioglu and Meinolf Sellmann in 2009. This method uses a dialectical approach to solving constrained optimization problems

mechanism: RFO discretizes each search-space coordinate into poker-rank sectors, applies three-point hand exchange and bluff mutation without binary encoding; ranked on the same AO leaderboard—population optimizer, not market sensing.
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing after full read—poker-metaphor genetic optimizer for parameter search only.
quote: Royal Flush Optimization (RFO), is a new approach to solving optimization problems that retains the main advantages of genetic algorithms but uses a more direct way of representing solutions.
